Incident Bot: :rotating_light: realtime-slo-detect: p99 latency > 5s on /v1/chat.stream for 6m — paging @oncall
Amina Rahman: Oncall Amina here, I'm seeing alerts. Grafana shows p95 steady ~600ms but p99 jumping to 7-9s. Streaming stalls count increasing. Kicking off initial checks.
Carlos Vega: No customer DMs yet. Frontend retries up ~12% in the last 10m. Running a few quick probes now from us-east.
Carlos Vega: `time curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST\" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat.stream -o /dev/null -s -w "%{time_total}\n"`
Priya Desai: I ran the probe from ap-south and saw times: 0.55, 0.63, 6.8, 0.58. Intermittent long tails. Suspect one pool or node class.
Amina Rahman: Check per-pool grpc errors and batching queue_time. Also check KV cache hit ratio and kvcache eviction rates.
Samir Gupta: Looking at serving telemetry — dedicated-gpu-3 shows sustained high grpc stream aborts and batching.queue_time peaking at 3800ms. Snippets:
Samir Gupta: ```
[2026-03-15T22:04:12Z] runtime: kvcache miss_ratio=0.89
[2026-03-15T22:04:14Z] grpc: stream aborted: ResourceExhausted
[2026-03-15T22:04:15Z] batching: queue_time_ms=3800
```
Carlos Vega: Autoscaler events: no scale-up in last 20m for dedicated-gpu-3. HPA shows desired 12, current 8 due to cooldown stuck. Possible scaler controller flapping.
Priya Desai: Also flag: spike in long-context requests (>6k tokens) from acct-enterprise-7 over last 30m. That will churn KV cache and blow up latencies for streaming.
Amina Rahman: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) circuit-break routing away from dedicated-gpu-3, 2) enable fast-fallback quantized variant for model-y, 3) temporarily apply per-account soft throttling for acct-enterprise-7 at 60rps.
Samir Gupta: I can set the drain: `redwoodctl pools drain --pool dedicated-gpu-3 --mode immediate` — will stop new sessions.
ops-bot: Routing change applied: pool dedicated-gpu-3 set to drain=true by Samir Gupta. Draining new streams now.
deploy-bot: Deploy request: runtime patch runtime/hotfix/queue-cooldown -> dedicated-gpu-3 initiated by Carlos Vega.
Carlos Vega: Enabled fallback: `redwoodctl fallback enable --model model-y --variant model-y-q --threshold-ms 1500`
Priya Desai: Applied account limiter: `ratectl set acct-enterprise-7 60 --burst 120 --reason "protect cluster p99"` — monitoring.
Amina Rahman: Quick verification: within 90s after routing change p99 dropped from ~8.2s to ~2.3s. Streaming-abort rate reduced. p95 now ~580ms.
Samir Gupta: Logs show in-flight connections finishing (some long streams ~20-35s). No node OOMs. Redeploy completed on 2/3 nodes; restart on last node in progress.
Carlos Vega: Prometheus query `sum(increase(grpc_server_streams_aborted_total[5m])) by (pool)` shows dedicated-gpu-3 +56, dedicated-gpu-4 +2.
Amina Rahman: Customer impact assessment: transient increase in latencies for a subset of sessions; some streaming clients experienced stalls and retried. No major HTTP 5xx surge outside retries. CS notify for acct-enterprise-7.
Priya Desai: Created follow-up INC-2026-0910, assigned to Solutions and Account Execs to contact acct-enterprise-7 and request reduced long-context ingestion pattern.
Samir Gupta: After redeploy and drain, pool metrics stabilized. p99 at ~420ms across clusters. I'll flip drain off after 10m of stability and confirm autoscaler resumes normal scale.
Amina Rahman: Actions for postmortem: - Root cause hypothesis: combined effect of kvcache churn from a noisy long-context tenant + autoscaler cooldown bug + batching cooldown regression in runtime. - Follow-ups: add per-account long-context alert, add autoscaler health heuristic, add runbook step for immediate route drains and fallback toggles.
ops-bot: Incident marked mitigated by Amina Rahman at 22:10 UTC. Incident record created and SRE rotation paged for RCA.
Carlos Vega: Handing off to next oncall for RCA; I've uploaded Grafana snapshots and the commands output to the ticket.
Priya Desai: I'll draft the RCA timeline and include the commands and exact queries. Linking metrics -> logs -> deployments.
Amina Rahman: Thanks all. Leaving the follow-ups in INC-2026-0910; re-open thread if p99 resurfaces. :thumbsup:
